Activate Device Owner (DP + Shizuku · ADB path)

Grants the DEVICE_POLICY_MANAGEMENT role (DP), then runs the official two-step dpm command via Shizuku (shell UID = ADB identity): “dpm set-active-admin” → “dpm set-device-owner”. Because shell UID counts as ADB, this path **does check accounts and extra users** — the app self-rescues on the first failure (see the note below). Use this when the device has already finished setup. Requires: Shizuku running and a release build.

This path runs as the app\'s own identity (non-ADB branch), which **never reads accounts** — no accounts or hidden users have to be removed. Its only hard gate is “device setup not yet completed”; if your device has already finished setup, the app closes that gate automatically for a few seconds and restores it right after.
Current device state — accounts: %1$d, users: %2$d (informational only; the non-ADB path ignores both)
Not supported on this Android version. The DEVICE_POLICY_MANAGEMENT role was introduced in Android 13 (API %1$d). Please use the Shizuku / Dhizuku activation entries below.

Preconditions not met. Remove all accounts (Settings → Accounts; system accounts can be signed out directly) and delete any work profile / clone / private space so that only the owner user remains, then retry. After removing accounts wait about 10 seconds before retrying.
Activate Device Owner via DP + Shizuku

This path runs as shell (ADB branch), so accounts and extra users are checked. If the first attempt fails, the app automatically deletes hidden user 999 and temporarily freezes the **non-system** apps that hold accounts, then retries and unfreezes them. In short: this card can clear the account gate for you, but it cannot bypass the “setup completed” gate.

Activates Device Owner **as the app’s own identity** without removing any account: first tap “Step 1: Prepare” to set user_setup_complete to 0 through Shizuku (opening the setup gate), then tap “Activate” to run forceUpdateUserSetupComplete → setActiveAdmin → setDeviceOwner, and user_setup_complete is restored to 1 as soon as the attempt ends. This branch **never reads accounts**, so your accounts can stay exactly as they are. Shizuku is required.

Order of operations: tap “Step 1: Prepare” first (temporarily setting user_setup_complete to 0), wait until it shows “Ready”, then tap “Activate”. The “Activate” button stays greyed out until preparation is done.
Note: This method has so far **only been verified on real Android 13 (API 33) devices**; other Android versions (14/15/16/17) are untested and may fail or behave unexpectedly.
While prepared, the system temporarily believes “setup has not been completed”. Within those few seconds the three-button navigation Home / Recents keys may stop responding (the Back key and gesture navigation are unaffected). Everything returns to normal the moment activation ends and user_setup_complete is restored to 1.
No account is removed and no data is wiped, but please make sure the battery is sufficient and do not force-shutdown the device or kill the app while it is running.

Runs the non-ADB direct activation (no account removal). Tap “Step 1: Prepare” above first to open the setup gate, then tap this button to activate; user_setup_complete is restored to 1 immediately whichever way the attempt ends. Shizuku is required.
Sets user_setup_complete to 0 temporarily through Shizuku. This step only “unlocks the door” and does not activate anything; tap “Activate” below once it is done. Shizuku is required.
Ready: the setup gate is open (user_setup_complete=0). You can tap “Activate” now.
Not ready: the setup gate is still closed. Tap “Step 1: Prepare” above first. The “Activate” button is disabled until then.

The DP Role is granted, but the MANAGE_PROFILE_AND_DEVICE_OWNERS permission has not taken effect yet. Common causes: (1) the role grant was just issued and the permission table has not refreshed (usually settles within seconds); (2) the app manifest does not declare this permission (left over from an older version — reinstalling the new build fixes it). Tap “Activate” to see the exact reason.

`%s`\n\nRun the three steps as commented: ① run the preparation commands on your computer; ② go back to the phone and tap “Activate” on this card (this step must be done by the app itself and cannot be replaced by a computer command); ③ after activation, run the restore command on your computer. Never paste ① and ③ together — that would set the setup gate back to 1 before activation and make it fail.

This device has already finished the setup wizard — the only hard gate of the non-ADB branch. The app handles it automatically: it temporarily sets user_setup_complete to 0 (through Shizuku), activates, then restores it to 1 whichever way the attempt ends. While it is 0, the three-button navigation Home / Recents keys stop responding (the Back key still works; gesture navigation is unaffected) and recover immediately afterwards. No account or user is ever removed.

The script runs the two-step shell command used by the official dpm tool: first “dpm set-active-admin”, then “dpm set-device-owner”. Shizuku executes it with shell UID, which AOSP treats identically to ADB (isAdb = shell or root UID).
